title: positions
description: One user's reading position for one book (sync/positions/{user}/{book}.json). Identity (user, book) lives in the file path, not the document. Merged as furthest-read-wins plus last-writer-wins current (DESIGN §4.5, §12).

furthest.description: The furthest point ever reached. Merged by max tuple (page_seq, char) regardless of timestamp (furthest-read-wins).

page_seq.description: 1-based page sequence number of the furthest position.

char.description: UTF-16 character offset within that page.

modified.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp this furthest value was recorded.

current.description: The current reading position ('Continue' opens this). Merged by greater 'modified' (last-writer-wins).

page_seq.description: 1-based page sequence number of the current position.

char.description: UTF-16 character offset within that page.

modified.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp this current position was recorded.

device.description: Optional label of the device that recorded this position (e.g. 'pixel8'), for display.
